regulatedTradeScope.electrical: NYC electrical work involving new wiring routes, added circuits, service equipment, new outlet or fixture locations, 220V/240V outlets, EV chargers, or permit-level electrical installations may require a NYC Licensed Master Electrician and DOB permit. Repair ASAP reviews photos and scope before booking fixture/device replacement, setup, and troubleshooting work.
regulatedTradeScope.plumbing: NYC plumbing work involving piping systems, gas piping, permit-level alterations, or non-cosmetic plumbing scope may require a Licensed Master Plumber and DOB permit. Repair ASAP reviews photos and scope before booking plumbing fixture work.
regulatedTradeScope.gasAppliances: Gas-ready dryer or range replacement/setup is reviewed before booking and must fit existing code-ready conditions. Gas piping, corrections, DOB filing, or work beyond compatible setup may require Licensed Master Plumber/DOB handling depending on the building and work requested.
regulatedTradeScope.applianceRepair: Appliance repair help is limited to handyman-compatible diagnosis, cleaning, connection, drain, vent, leveling, replacement, and setup scope after photo review. Sealed-system refrigerator work, refrigerant, compressor replacement, board-level electronics, manufacturer warranty service, new gas piping, hidden plumbing, new circuits, hardwired changes, or permit-level work may require a specialized technician, manufacturer-authorized service, Licensed Master Plumber, Licensed Master Electrician, or DOB permit.
